Name: Vietnamese Beverage
Author: IAMJULIES
Description:
[size=6][font=Impact]Description[/font][/size]
Welcome to the active preview of Vietnamese Beverage! This mod introduces the rich, aromatic, and distinct world of Vietnamese drink culture to Pelican Town. From robust street-side coffees to refreshing tropical juices and authentic mountain spirits, this pack aims to completely level up your Stardew Valley beverage game.

[i][b]Please note:[/b] This is an active Early Access/Demo release published primarily to configure update keys and gather initial feedback.[/i]

[b][i][size=4]🍹 Currently Featured (6 of 7 Planned Items)[/size][/i][/b]
We have successfully implemented 6 core drinks, custom crops, a custom fruit tree, an artisan machine, and a dedicated balance framework in this preview release:
* The Legendary Egg Coffee (Cà Phê Trứng): A sweet, liquid masterpiece combining strong, robust coffee with a rich, velvety egg-yolk foam layer.
* Vietnamese Iced Milk Coffee (Cà Phê Sữa Đá): The ultimate street-side classic. A potent, slow-dripped coffee sweetened with rich condensed milk over ice—guaranteed to give your farmer a serious energy kick!
* Salt Coffee (Cà Phê Muối): A trendy, modern specialty. A perfect, sophisticated harmony of bitter robusta coffee, sweet condensed milk, and a savory, creamy salted foam top layer.
* Sugarcane Juice & Custom Crop (Nước Mía): Introduce a brand new tropical crop—Sugarcane (Cây Mía)—to your farm and press it into a super refreshing street drink. The ultimate way to beat the summer heat!
* Pennywort Juice, Custom Crop & Blender Station (Nước Rau Má): Grow vibrant clusters of Pennywort (Rau Má) and grind them into a nutrient-packed juice using a brand new artisan machine—the Blender! Features fully functional mechanical sound effects while operating.
* Hmong Apple Wine & Custom Fruit Tree (Rượu Táo Mèo): Harvest tart, aromatic Hmong Apples (Táo Mèo) from custom fruit trees and ferment them into a famous traditional mountain wine! Indulge in its deep flavor, but watch out for its alcoholic kick!
[size=4][b][i]⚙️ Enhanced Beverage Balance Framework[/i][/b][/size]
To prevent game-breaking stat inflation and overlapping drink effects, this mod integrates a custom drink buff management framework. All beverage effects are carefully balanced to maintain the vanilla game's challenge and progression.

---
[b][i][size=1]⚠️ Gameplay Guide & Secrets[/size][/i][/b]
[size=1]Below are the gameplay mechanics, crop statistics, unlocking conditions, and hidden interactions wrapped in spoiler tags![/size]

[spoiler]The Blender Machine:
* How to trigger: Once you harvest or ship your very first batch of Pennywort (Rau Má), Robin will notice this unique ingredient. The next morning, she will send an invitation letter directly to your mailbox.
* Where to purchase: Reading her invitation letter will officially unlock the Blender Crafting Recipe for purchase at Robin's Carpenter Shop.
* Sugarcane Seeds (Seed Cane): Purchased exclusively from Sandy at the Oasis shop in the Calico Desert.
* Pennywort Seeds (Hạt Rau Má):
    * Seasons: Grows in both Spring and Summer.
    * Growth Cycle: Takes 4 days to fully mature, then regrows every 3 days.
    * Special Mechanics: Grows noticeably faster in moist/wet soil. Must be harvested using a Scythe (Liềm) to yield fresh, lush clusters.
* Hmong Apple Tree (Cây Táo Mèo): A custom fruit tree that yields tart Hmong Apples, ideal for fermenting into specialty wine.
* Sugarcane Juice: Excellent for continuous stamina refills during busy farming days.
* Pennywort Juice (Nước Rau Má):
    * Recovery: Restores a massive amount of Stamina and Health.
    * Special Buff (Thanh Nhiệt Giải Độc): Instantly cures all debuffs! Cleanses slime slowdowns or defense breaks from monsters in Skull Cavern or Volcano Dungeon.
* Hmong Apple Wine (Rượu Táo Mèo):
    * Effect: Grants a unique warmth and energy boost, but triggers a realistic Tipsy/Drunk status effect upon consumption.
    * 🥛 Secret Counter / Hidden Interaction: Drinking Milk (Sữa) immediately neutralizes and removes the Tipsy/Drunk status effect caused by Hmong Apple Wine! [/spoiler]
